guide_enrichment.narrative: For us, the case for Rice is less about identifying the better team and more about questioning how consistently Tulsa can create separation. Tulsa’s underlying profile is strong at reaching scoring territory, but that has not always translated into touchdowns: it scored on 12 of its first 46 offensive drives. We are not treating the six-point performance at Arkansas as predictive, though one score across 11 drives with five three-and-outs illustrates the volatility in this offense.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch: We are watching Tulsa’s ability to turn favorable field position into touchdowns against a Rice defense that has struggled to prevent scoring opportunities. Tulsa has enough rushing efficiency to move the ball, but sustained drives and finishing them are different questions. If Tulsa consistently converts those chances, it can challenge our Rice position; if those possessions again end without touchdowns, the game is more likely to remain within the tighter range our model expects.
